summary: Discussion-first snapshot: major vendor agent launches and security incidents (OpenAI Dots, training pause), Anthropic/Meta product fallout, plus operator reports on harnesses, multi-agent runs, and MCP/memory tooling. Several infra projects appear but many are single-source social/GitHub posts needing corroboration. | Vendor-only sweep: bedrock AgentCore, OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol, Cloudflare sandbox/tooling & monetization, modal/e2b/daytona sandbox scale, multiple GHSA advisories, Anthropic containment/partnerships, several platform product updates. | Snapshot of GitHub OSS signals: multiple major vendor releases (Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel), GitHub blog workflows, and rising infra primitives for agent security, memory, and eval; several repo-only projects need corroboration. | Packages-only snapshot: multiple VS Code extensions and vendor packages showing agent-facing features (MCP, memory, observability, security); missing social/operator reports for real-world workflows.
